name: silent-hill-2
label: Silent Hill 2 (the remake, in VR with UEVR)
notes: From the Silent Hill 2 VR project's notes (2026-11-21 reader note and the control profile's KNOWN.md). Tefa's rules for this game: DLSS stays on, view distance is never lowered (no pop-in), the fog is left alone, the ray-tracing geometry switches stay as they are, r.ScreenPercentage is never changed live (each live change rebuilt DLSS, the event three crashes came after; SH2-019). Left out on purpose: every sg.* group (they do nothing here: the game sets its own values), view distance, the fog grid, the ray-tracing geometry switches, all ray tracing off (the light shows), the six values our plugin's tuning.cpp re-sets every 5 s (they would be fought), and r.ScreenPercentage until SH2-019 is settled.

launch.say: The Silent Hill 2 VR mod's own launcher (SH2VR.exe, in its package folder). Steam must be running. `play --sim` starts the game with the pretend headset and loads UEVR by itself.

to_play.say: the game window (a shader compile can add a minute)
past the content warning (PRESS ANY BUTTON TO CONTINUE)
Continue: loads the newest save slot (the swapped-in one on a save jump)
past PRESS ANY BUTTON TO PLAY (Enter works there too)

quit.say: the console's quit closes the game cleanly in about 10 s; the UEVR injector window stays and is closed after

settings.label: Silent Hill 2 in UEVR: the live-safe levers only

knobs.label: DLSS level
knobs.note: edit only with the game closed; never through the game's menu while playing (SH2-019)

connector.name: UEVR-MCP
connector.say: elliotttate's UEVR-MCP: its plugin in the UEVR profile's plugins folder, its server for the AI. Once measured at about 7 ms a frame, once at nothing: The Optimizer measures its cost itself.
